hotel_name: Super Hotel O By Oyo Iskcon Temple Rohini Formerly Golden Key

positive_snippets:
I arrived at the hotel without prior booking in the early morning (about 03:00 am). Soft spoken, Mr Vishal (Goni) was on duty.

I was pleased by the service provided in such odd hours and his skill of maintaining a smile , softness and politeness despite of being disturbed in Sleep 💤 and having disagreements on few points.
It was a good experience, opposite of iskcon temple and a huge park in front of the hotel with no parking issue. The staff was well behaved and served well. Rooms could have been better.
negative_snippets: Smoking smell and not clean. Not recommended for family.
